title: Hopper Launch Items
description: This datapack makes it so that hoppers facing air will shoot out the items it has inside -ONLY WORKS IF U STAND ON THE HOPPER AND DO /function hopper_launch/hopper_place so it wont ruin your other redstone builds which dont want hoppers shooting items.
body:
This datapack makes it so that hoppers facing "air" will shoot out the items it has inside **(ONLY WORKS IF U STAND ON THE HOPPER AND DO /function hopper_launch/hopper_place)** so it wont ruin your other redstone builds which dont want hoppers shooting items.

**the item can be caught by another hopper! it acts as a dropped/thrown item.**

**make sure you stand and crouch to fit on top of the hopper, then do:                   
/function hopper_launch/hopper_place (makes the hopper you are standing on be able to shoot items if facing air)**

to remove it, simply do **/kill @e[type=marker] and put your range.** Also break the hopper :)

ignore /function hopper_launch/hopper_break, for testing purposes!


May not work on versions below 1.21.4
